scope: Best-AICc model-class prevalence in the public saved PETS empirical comparison object; not mechanistic-interpretation prevalence.

source.paper: Bruhn Kinneberg et al. 2026, Rate-time scaling in phenotypic evolution: Limitations of current models in capturing temporal dynamics

audit_execution.operation: which.min(AICc) for each saved model_test entry

discrepancy_log.paper_complete_vs_saved_object: Paper describes 643 complete empirical series; public saved model_test object contains 630 entries. Exact model-class counts use 630 only.
discrepancy_log.URW_paper_vs_saved_object: Paper reports 163 time series in the URW relative-fit subset; direct saved-object minimum-AICc audit gives 164 URW minima. Treat as an unresolved processing/version/filtering difference, not as a source error.

inference: OU likelihood classes are nontrivially represented in a broad empirical evolutionary time-series comparison: 125/630 saved successful model comparisons have an OU model as minimum AICc, including 56 fixed OU and 69 moving OUBM. This is model-class prevalence, not prevalence of mechanistic causal interpretation.
hard_stops: do not use 643 as the denominator for these exact counts
do not translate 125 OU-best series into 125 affected published papers
do not treat minimum AICc as proof that OU is the true process
do not infer mechanistic-interpretation prevalence from model-class prevalence
